0.original: Ranulf wants to help the Barber.

24.original: Scatter the fine powder at the designated location and obtain a bottle of antlion secretion from the antlion ambusher.

25.original: Deliver the bottle of antlion secretion to Ranulf.

48.original: Think you'd be able to lend me a hand?

49.original: I've been trying to gather supplies for the Barber. While I've managed to get some blankets and bandages, I've not been able to procure any disinfectant. That's what I need your help for─I want you to bring me a bottle of antlion secretion.

50.original: I'll collect the other ingredients I need. I just need you to slay an antlion.

51.original: Only the antlions that dwell beneath the earth secrete the kind of liquid I need. Use this to draw them to the surface.

52.original: It's a powder made of crushed ants, their favorite food. Scatter it anywhere they're known to dwell and you'll be faced with one in no time at all.

53.original: Head to Virdjala in the Fringes. You'll not struggle to find an antlion there.

54.original: Scatter that powder in Virdjala and slay any antlions that come to the surface. Don't forget to collect the liquid they secrete!

56.original: Exactly what I needed. I'll be able to make enough disinfectant to last a while with this.

57.original: Even the smallest of wounds can be fatal if they become infected. We can't let the Barber run out of the stuff.
